narrative_purpose: The dim, immersive mood layer the chapter's text floats over: the whole living moon glimpsed from far orbit as one faint breathing organism, so wide and atmospheric that no single subject competes with the prose.
subject: An ultra-wide, very distant view of the curve of the habitable moon filling the lower frame, its night side threaded all over with the faintest scattered web of bioluminescent light, the gas giant Polyphemus a vast dim presence above, everything dissolving into deep atmospheric haze and the black of space.
scene: A far-orbital vista, the moon's curved limb low across the frame, faint planet-wide glow, Polyphemus dim above, deep space haze throughout.
camera: An ultra-wide, very distant orbital view, everything small, deep and atmospheric.
light: Very low-key: the faintest cool bioluminescent speckle across the moon's dark side, deep shadow everywhere else; deliberately dark and low-contrast so overlaid text stays legible.
palette: Dominant void-indigo and deep teal-indigo, only the faintest threads of Pandora cyan glow, almost no warm accent.
style: Painterly speculative-astronomy naturalist plate, atmospheric, soft, detail dissolving into haze.
detail_level: Low overall — no crisp focal subject; everything soft, distant and dim, dissolving into atmospheric depth.
composition: Wide horizontal mood field with deep haze, the moon's limb low, no bright focal point, generous dark expanses across the whole frame for text overlay.
consistency_notes: Macro establishing mood for this chapter; dark, low-contrast, immersive; same cool Pandora palette and from-within glow as the chapter cover but far dimmer and wider.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style, no bright central subject, no spacecraft
